t: The Love Boat: Caribbean Cruise: Call Me Grandma/A Gentleman of Discretion/The Perfect Divorce/Letting Go - Part 2
st: Caribbean Cruise: Call Me Grandma/A Gentleman of Discretion/The Perfect Divorce/Letting Go - Part 2
d: A stiff British ex-military officer is put in charge of the fun-loving and energy-filled Menudo group; a young couple is confouded because Doc seems very much in love with his visiting ex-wife, a fact Doc attributes to the fact that he is divorced.

t: The Love Boat: The Spoonmaker Diamond - Part 2
d: Romance and intrigue combine with the mystery of a famous international jewel as The Love Boat sails amid the scenic beauty of the Aegean Sea - including the glorious sights of the Greek Islands and Turkey.

t: The Love Boat: Venetian Love Song - Part 1
d: While the Pacific Princess sails through the beautiful waters of Italy, a seemingly happy couple (Shelly Winters and Ernest Borgnine) reveals that their relationship is far from perfect.

t: The Love Boat: Venetian Love Song - Part 2
d: Love, adventure and romantic hijinks are afloat when The Love Boat sails to the beautiful Eternal City of Rome and the sites of glorious Capri and Venice in a special two-hour premiere.

t: The Love Boat: Same Wavelength/ Winning Isn't Everything/ A Honeymoon For Horace
st: Same Wavelength/ Winning Isn't Everything/ A Honeymoon For Horace
d: A mindreader meets a man and uses the reading to improve her chances at getting his attention. Meanwhile, Capt. Stubing's friend brags about his son's accomplishments, but Vicki hears a totally different story.

t: The Love Boat: Too Many Dads/ Love Will Find A Way/ The Best Of Friends
st: Too Many Dads/ Love Will Find A Way/ The Best Of Friends
d: A 10-year-old boy is torn between his biological father, who he hasn't seen since he was a baby, and the stepfather who raised him. Meanwhile, Elaine tries to tell her parents that her fiance is a paraplegic.

t: The Love Boat: The Tomorrow Lady/ Father, Dear Father/ Still Life
st: The Tomorrow Lady/ Father, Dear Father/ Still Life
d: A woman's (Greer Garson) ability to see the future may hinder her relationship with an attractive man. Plus, a single mother thinks she meets a divorced man traveling with his daughter, but that's not exactly the case.

t: The Love Boat: The Christmas Presence
d: Angelorum Dominicus suddenly appears aboard the Pacific Princess without a reservation and soon begins to spread love and happiness to everyone on the cruise, especially a little boy in need of an operation.

t: The Love Boat: The Groupies/ The Audition/ Doc'S Nephew
st: The Groupies/ The Audition/ Doc'S Nephew
d: A female producer is adamant about not wanting to start a relationship with an actor, but the thespian has other plans. Meanwhile, a therapist goes on a cruise with his group, while Doc and his nephew compete for the affection of the same woman.

t: The Love Boat: The Captain's Replacement/ Sly As A Fox/ Here Comes The Bride -- Maybe
st: The Captain's Replacement/ Sly As A Fox/ Here Comes The Bride -- Maybe
d: When Gopher suspects a skipper under Capt. Stubing's tutelage is trying to take his job, the crew jumps into action to protect their boss. Meanwhile, a lovely lady causes havoc when she boards with two men who are each after her hand.

t: The Love Boat: Gopher's Daisy/ Our Son, The Lawyer/ Salvaged Romance
st: Gopher's Daisy/ Our Son, The Lawyer/ Salvaged Romance
d: A woman's (Joan Rivers) shyness around men is exacerbated by her recent mastectomy that is until she meets an understanding man. Meanwhile, when a married couple contemplates divorce, it's their son, who's also a lawyer, that gets caught in the middle.

st: Fountain Of Youth/ Bad Luck Cabin/ Uncle Daddy
d: When an elderly man's granddaughter falls for one of his fresh-faced friends, the man seeks out some of the youth potion for himself. Meanwhile, things start moving a little too fast for Isaac and the woman he's dating.

t: The Love Boat: The Professor Has Class/ When The Magic Disappears/ We, The Jury
st: The Professor Has Class/ When The Magic Disappears/ We, The Jury
d: A sarcastic woman (Anne Meara) goes on a rampage when she finds out she's on a cruise with the same man she's suing (Jerry Stiller) for damages. Meanwhile, a famous professor meets a former student who is hired to replace his mentor/

t: The Love Boat: The Captain's Crush/ Out Of My Hair/ Off-Course Romance
st: The Captain's Crush/ Out Of My Hair/ Off-Course Romance
d: When Stubing meets a gorgeous movie queen (Joan Collins), who recently shed her ninth husband, he is fascinated by her charm and beauty. Then, a man decides to prioritize golf over his wife, so the neglected woman decides to play ball with an old friend.

t: The Love Boat: Discount Romance/ Vicky'S Dilemma/ Loser, And Still Champ
st: Discount Romance/ Vicky'S Dilemma/ Loser, And Still Champ
d: The captain's daughter is put in a tough situation she is accused of stealing supplements from Doc's office. Then, Gopher's uncle (Red Button) falls in love with the lady who runs the ship's gift shop.

t: The Love Boat: So Help Me Hannah/ The Maid Cleans Up/ Cpr, I.O.U
st: So Help Me Hannah/ The Maid Cleans Up/ Cpr, I.O.U
d: The vivacious Hannah Harvye (Mary Martin) immediately becomes involved with the crew and rekindles a romance with an old flame. An unassuming man (Ben Murphy) finds himself in a tight situation with a maid he's never met. Gopher saves a man's life.

t: The Love Boat: Love Boat - The World's Greatest Kisser/ Don'T Take My Wife, Please/ The Reluctant Father
st: Love Boat - The World's Greatest Kisser/ Don'T Take My Wife, Please/ The Reluctant Father
d: A jilted fiance hires a Mata Hari (Elaine Joyce) to find the crew member that ruined his wedding plans; a junior executive (Parker Stevenson) suffers in silence while his boss (David Doyle) lusts after his bride.
